messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail.

message.content: {"animals": ["eagle", "octopus"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large standing bird with the head, feathered body, folded wings, and yellow taloned feet of a brown eagle, shown in right-facing profile. The plumage is rich brown with layered wing feathers and shaggy feathering on the neck and upper legs. From the rear underside where a tail would be, a cluster of brown octopus-like tentacles with pale round suckers hangs down and curls. Additional pale circular sucker marks are scattered over the feathered lower breast and thighs.", "extra_limb_pieces": 7, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "brown feathered eagle head", "part": "head", "where": "at the top front of the body"}, {"looks_like": "hooked raptor beak, yellow at the base and dark gray at the hooked tip", "part": "beak", "where": "on the front of the head"}, {"looks_like": "golden-brown eagle eye with dark pupil", "part": "eye", "where": "on the side of the head"}, {"looks_like": "folded feathered eagle wings with overlapping coverts and long flight feathers", "part": "wings", "where": "on the sides of the body with tips pointing to the rear, one prominent on the near side and one partially visible on the far side"}, {"looks_like": "thick feathered bird legs", "part": "legs", "where": "on the lower body supporting the bird"}, {"looks_like": "yellow scaly bird feet with four toes each", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom of the legs"}, {"looks_like": "long curved black claws", "part": "talons", "where": "on the tips of the toes"}, {"looks_like": "dense brown layered feathers", "part": "feathers", "where": "covering the head, neck, body, wings and upper legs"}, {"looks_like": "long tapering brown octopus arms with mottled skin", "part": "tentacles", "where": "hanging from the rear underside in place of a tail and curling at the tips"}, {"looks_like": "pale round cups with central pits", "part": "suckers", "where": "in rows along the undersides of the tentacles and scattered on the lower belly and thighs"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "walking_legs": 2, "wings": 2}
